author: OldManTigerMask
body:
Hey guys,

So recently I've been seeing a lot of map packs being thrown around and I thought why can't I do that as well... So I thought about making a map pack with maybe one or two other people. We will be making 2 - 5 maps and they will be submitted to Avicus. Contact me through Skype (blockosnetwork@ncst.com.au) or Teamspeak. I'm really looking forward to working with you!

Please comment below and tell me if you're interested! Thought I clarify that you don't have to help with every map, you can just help with one.

Bye,
Tiger

replies.body:
Hey, I'm up for making some maps with others on Avic. I've mainly built structures and redstone mechanics and have a slight knowledge of building maps, but I'd love to properly build one to go onto a server like Avic! Unfortunately I'd be unable to speak through Skype or TeamSpeak which could cause complications, but we could talk through text and I have some great ideas, plus experience with WorldEdit.

Hope I can help,
City
